title: Convert HierarchySelection and AdjacentItems to @freezed instead of hand-rolled/missing equality
rule: coding-standards.md:584 — never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes
why: coding-standards.md is explicit: 'hand-rolled equality drifts from the fields and silently breaks rebuild-skipping.' HierarchySelection is stored in `Set<HierarchySelection>` in production code (bulk_mark_screen.dart:68, hierarchy_selection_panel.dart:88) — Set.add/remove/contains rely directly on ==/hashCode. All 4 fields are covered today, but the next field added to the class (a plausible edit given it already models a 4-level hierarchy with headroom) will silently break selection dedup in the bulk-mark/lifetime-marking flows unless the two overrides are manually kept in sync. AdjacentItems has no equality at all (identity-only), so two structurally-equal instances never compare equal — currently harmless since it's only null-checked, but not an @freezed value type either.
recommendation: Annotate both as @freezed (or add copyWith by hand and a comment justifying why not, matching the project's stated carve-out pattern) so equality/hashCode/copyWith stay generated and in sync with the fields.
acceptance_criteria: HierarchySelection and AdjacentItems are @freezed classes; all existing == /hashCode assertions in hierarchy_selection_test.dart and epic_25_schema_core_test.dart still pass unchanged.
Set<HierarchySelection> usage in bulk_mark_screen.dart and hierarchy_selection_panel.dart compiles and behaves identically.
